## D — State Laws and Rules
Accuracy scope: State Laws and Rules facts use the pinned official PDF and one physical page per fact; original phrasing preserves actor qualifications, exceptions and modal verbs.
The general title requirement is qualified by the age and vehicle exceptions; motorcycle and commercial-vehicle details are outside this standard-driver dossier. [A17]
Registration amounts and administrative channels are edition-bound and need monitoring; no current fee change is inferred. [A18]
The inspection-sticker passage uses ambiguous loss-of-points wording; the learner fact preserves only a possible point consequence pending clarification. [A20]
The sound rule contains a combined distance-and-decibel test plus a separate reasonableness alternative; both conditions are retained. [A22]
Confidence process: every drafted fact received a same-model source-context check before submission; independent coverage and hallucination QA remain pending.
Officeholders, telephone numbers and changing administrative details are excluded from stable learner statements. No source attribution is a legal or clinical signoff.
